verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a public REST API with authentication, endpoints for checkout, sale, get decision, chargebacks and webhook creation, plus a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a Try It panel, a versioning policy and test teams for safe use. Some docs are gated behind login, and the llms.txt probe returned 404 despite a claim that it is served. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use, a fully ungated reference (some Enterprise docs need login), and a published changelog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
